name: Sentinel Farsong
summary: At Silverwing Grove, Sentinel Farsong guards Ashenvale’s southern border. She rallies champions against the Warsong Outriders in Warsong Gulch.

sections.title: Guardian of Silverwing Grove
sections.body: Sentinel Farsong watches Silverwing Grove as the Warsong clan cuts lumber and pushes into night elf lands. She calls Alliance champions to strike at the Warsong Outriders and sends field reports to Silverwing command. Her work checks the Horde’s advance and helps protect the woods.

faq.answer: Sentinel Farsong serves with the Silverwing Sentinels in Ashenvale. She is stationed at Silverwing Grove near the entrance to Warsong Gulch, where she recruits Alliance adventurers and gathers battle intelligence.
Sentinel Farsong is at Silverwing Grove in southeastern Ashenvale, where the Alliance stages its efforts in Warsong Gulch.

faq.q: Why is she fighting the Warsong Outriders?
faq.answer: The Warsong Outriders harvest timber and defile Ashenvale’s sacred forests. Sentinel Farsong helps defend the woods and recover territory claimed by the Horde.

angles.text: Sentinel Farsong directs Alliance volunteers against the Warsong Clan in Ashenvale.
As a protector of Elune’s sacred woods, Sentinel Farsong reflects the kaldorei’s resolve to drive out those who defile the ancient groves.
